body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 494a7c3653e3345bab5f77e2ed355c08628ad6b9 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good
- No second derivation of the posted word. The diff adds no G54..G59 table: UI and MCP read `setup::work_offset_names`, `setup_offsets::index`, `setup::wcs_name`; `entry_label` only words a name taken from the post's own table. `setup::wcs_slot` and `Manifest::translate` are untouched by this PR.
- Nothing clamps, defaults or remaps. `setup_offsets::parse_index` (setup_offsets.rs) checks shape and 1..=MAX_SLOT+1 only, refusing by text; the post's range is judged by `SetSetupWorkOffset::new` -> `setup_offsets::check` (#1113), by setup name. Index to slot is `n - 1` after the >= 1 filter, so no underflow remap. `index` plus `word` that disagree are refused, not picked.
- MCP `set_work_offset` (setup_tools.rs) runs the same `SetSetupWorkOffset` through History as the GUI, so undo holds. The picker only queues that command.
- UI combo (setup_wcs_pick.rs): lists 1..=post max; a stored pick beyond the post stays visible as "Work offset n - not on this post" and is never shown as offset 1; the post gate still refuses it.
- Tests: mcp_work_offset (4), UI AccessKit tests for 6 vs 9 entries and the beyond-range pick, structural twin updated. No snapshot PNG changed. Maintainer hand check and Hub run recorded in the body (d97157c2).

Merge commits (git show --remerge-diff of each, base 9720520e..494a7c36 and earlier)
- 494a7c36 (hand-resolved): only `crates/app/src/operation/types/mod.rs`, one blank line around `pub use sel::...`; main's text kept. No logic.
- 9720520e: same file (kept main's `LEGACY_WCS_NAMES` form, no WCS_SLOTS re-export from the other side - matches main after #1113) and structural.rs (both sides kept: main's `cylinder_pick`/`origin_pick` assert plus this PR's work-offset combo asserts). Test-side only.
- a647df4b: SKILL.md (kept main's `set_wcs_circle_centre`/`set_wcs_from_features` rows plus the new `set_work_offset` row), setup_tools.rs TOOLS table (both lines kept: `set_work_offset` index form, `set_program`), PROCESS_VERSION. No logic change.
- Earlier merges (d97157c2, 5209b835, 896fc976, 0f34ac74, 202224f0): PROCESS_VERSION renumbering; 0f34ac74 also the TOOLS table (both entries kept). No logic change.
- Net diff against origin/main touches no `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` (0 hits), so the older bumps are gone from the final tree. Body says "Process change: yes"; the SKILL.md row is the process file. OK.

Holds / change requests: none. No review exists on the PR; the comments by mkinney and NeoTech are refresh notes and the hand-check report; none states a hold.

Results merged with main (3e18717a)
- On the self-hosted runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43541032680 - conclusion success, trial merge with main clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: app suites ok, ui suites ok, 0 failed (the run's wall was 1.9 min).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run locally: the diff adds no `cfg(windows)` or per-OS pinned value, so no local Windows rerun is owed.

Requested before merge
None.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The MCP refusal is pinned against the default 6-offset post only; the Tormach range (9) is pinned in app and UI tests (the body says so).
- The probe page's "Set G54..G59" is left alone on purpose (the body says so).
- Not exercised by me: the GUI, a user .cps post, the release lanes. The body records the maintainer's GUI hand check and Hub run on d97157c2.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
